goal: Play a full round: put out fires, rescue everyone, refill water
summary: The playtester never got past the lobby. It walked to within about 10 studs of the Mission Board and tried to use the 'Pick a call' prompt three times (steps 3, 5, 8), and every attempt returned 'held, not triggered'. No round started, so no fires, rescues or refills were tested. The server probe reported no errors.

bugs.title: Mission Board 'Pick a call' prompt never triggers, so no round can start
bugs.evidence: Steps 3, 5 and 8: interacting with Workspace.Map.Station.Lobby.MissionBoard at about 10 studs (reported range 16, hold 0 and 0.3s with E) returned 'held, not triggered' every time. The player was still in the Lobby with no SquadId or InstanceId set. The round could not start, which blocked the whole goal. It may be a prompt or trigger problem, an obstruction between the player and the board, or the prompt needing a closer distance than it reports.

bugs.title: Pathfinding returns NoPath in the lobby and walks stop short of targets
bugs.evidence: Step 1: walk to MissionBoard stopped 35.6 studs away (NoPath). Step 4: walk to (-40,3.5,167) stopped 6.7 studs short (NoPath, timeout). Step 7: walk to SquadPad2 stopped 22.6 studs short (NoPath, timeout). The lobby navmesh may be missing or blocked, or the lobby geometry may be obstructing movement. This could also explain why the player could not get close enough to the board.
